purpose: Identify the SNR floor at which the F-003 algebraic signature (minimum residual ratio at Q = 0.5) is still detectable under Gaussian measurement noise. Establishes the measurement-quality requirement for real-substrate F-003 replication.
interpretation: F-003 algebraic signature detectable under 2σ rule down to SNR = 30 dB. Real-substrate measurements must achieve at least this SNR for the signature to survive noise. At SNRs above ~40 dB the contrast is robust; below ~20 dB the noise drowns the signature regardless of Q.
